UK.basis: Share sales = 'arranging deals in investments' (RAO art.25) unless art.70 sale-of-body-corporate exclusion (>50% voting shares, or ≤50 employees-type tests) applies; asset sales unregulated; property needs no licence but estate agency rules (EAA 1979) may apply to business transfers
UK.verified: primary/reputable (note: RAO being restated under FSMA 2023)

AU.basis: Business agents licensed under state property/agent acts (e.g. NSW Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 'business agent'; QLD/VIC similar); unlicensed agents generally cannot recover commission

SG.basis: Advising on take-over/arrangement of a company or acquiring/disposing capital markets products = corporate finance advice needing CMS licence (or exemption); pure asset-sale brokerage unclear

CA.basis: Provincial real estate acts cover business sales: BC RESA (BCFSA 'Sale of a Business' guideline); Ontario REBBA 2002 s.9 bars unregistered parties from suing for commission (Geofre v. Li, 2012 ONSC 5777)

IE.basis: PSRA licence (Property Services (Regulation) Act 2011) required where land/leases/property are part of the sale; pure asset sale without property appears outside PSRA; share-sale arranging may be MiFID-regulated

DE.basis: Unternehmensmakler needs only a Gewerbeanmeldung; §34c GewO permit only for brokering land/commercial premises/loans; GmbH share deals not KWG financial instruments in typical M&A. Asset sale excluding real estate -> no licence
DE.commission_scope: asset sale, no real estate, no funds held

FR.basis: Loi Hoguet (loi 70-9, décret 72-678) requires a carte professionnelle for intermediaries in sale of fonds de commerce; unlicensed intermediary cannot claim fees

NL.basis: No specific bedrijfsmakelaar licence found; AFM Wft licence covers financial services, not business brokerage; share-sale arranging edge cases unverified

ES.basis: No national licence for intermediaries in compraventa de empresas; platforms openly charge success fees (e.g. Deale 2.5%); real-estate agent registers only regional (e.g. Catalonia) and only for property
ES.commission_scope: asset sale, no real estate, no funds held

IT.basis: Legge 39/1989: agente d'affari in mediazione (incl. aziende) must be registered with the Camera di Commercio; unregistered mediator has no right to commission (art.6)

CH.basis: Brokerage (Mäklervertrag, CO art.412ff) unlicensed at federal level; FINMA licensing targets securities firms, not private business sales; some cantons regulate real-estate brokerage only
CH.commission_scope: asset sale, no real estate, no funds held

NZ.basis: Real Estate Agents Act 2008: 'transaction' includes sale of a business; agency work requires REA licence and unlicensed work is an offence

HK.basis: Share deals: advising/arranging may need SFC Type 1/6 licence; pure asset sale introductions appear unlicensed; unverified to primary guidance

AE.basis: Business brokerage is a specific licensed trade activity (DED/free-zone licence) ; operating unlicensed in Dubai is not permitted

IN.basis: No licence for private business-sale finders (SMERGERS charges 1% finder fee); SEBI merchant-banker/intermediary rules for securities issues; FEMA for cross-border

JP.basis: SME Agency M&A support-institution registration is voluntary (needed only for subsidy-eligible fees); no licence for M&A intermediation of asset deals; follow SME M&A Guidelines
JP.commission_scope: asset sale, no real estate, no funds held

ZA.basis: Property Practitioners Act 2019 (in force 2022) brings business brokers under PPRA registration/Fidelity Fund certificate

BR.basis: CRECI licence only for real-estate brokerage; 'corretoras de empresas'/M&A boutiques operate unlicensed for business sales (Civil Code arts.722-729 corretagem)
